quick_ratio.formula: (Accounts receivable + Prepayments, deposits and other assets + Other financial assets + Financial assets at fair value through profit or loss + Financial assets at fair value through other comprehensive income + Term deposits + Restricted cash + Cash and cash equivalents - Inventories) / Notes payable
quick_ratio.reason: Tencent has 3.7930 times its assumed current liabilities in quick assets, suggesting strong short-term liquidity, though this is based on an incomplete current liabilities breakdown.

debt_to_equity_ratio.formula: (Borrowings + Notes payable) / Equity attributable to equity holders of the Company
debt_to_equity_ratio.reason: Tencent's debt-to-equity ratio of 0.2846 indicates that the company uses a relatively low amount of debt to finance its assets compared to equity.

debt_to_capital_ratio.formula: (Borrowings + Notes payable) / (Borrowings + Notes payable + Equity attributable to equity holders of the Company)
debt_to_capital_ratio.reason: About 22.16% of Tencent's total capital (debt plus equity) is composed of debt, indicating a healthy capital structure.

debt_to_ebitda_ratio.formula: (Borrowings + Notes payable) / (Operating profit + Depreciation and Amortization)
